title: Up and Down the Ladder v2
author: Sionnach
rules:
This is only my second puzzle, any feedback would be appreciated!

Normal sudoku rules apply - Place the digits 1 - 9 exactly once in each row, column, and box

Arrow - Digits on an arrow must sum to the digit in its bulb

Parity Lines - Digits on a red line must alternate in parity (odd/even)

German Whispers - Adjacent digits along a green line must have a difference of at least 5

Play on sudokupad
